content.description:
Hey there, We are a team of three Cardano enthusiasts with a passion for art, gaming and technology.

My name is ToneDice, a UX Designer by profession with more than 13 years of industry experience, and multimedia artist by passion. Along with me for this amazing journey are Zitro, who is the main artist and gamer behind MinecraftCNFT, and Cap who is our idea master and marketer with more than 15 years of industry experience.

NFTs fundamentally change how people can collect and trade art. We strongly believe that it’s here to stay. And we want to enhance this to also include being able to play with these NFT art pieces.

We sincerely hope that you are going to like MinecraftCNFT and enjoy the ride with us. We have a long-term goal with this project, putting in many ideas every day to make this happen. You are welcome to reach out to talk about MinecraftCNFT and propose/discuss ideas about this project. We always want to get feedback from the community. We are constantly updating our roadmap so you guys can have a clear understanding of what we are trying to achieve with MinecraftCNFT.

We are not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Minecraft™ or Mojang.
